# CLI: VKS

## get-quota

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode vks get-quota --query Quota
```

## list-cluster-versions

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh
greennode vks list-cluster-versions
```

## list-clusters

Kind: Read.

Pages start at 0, with a default size of 10. Each call reads one page. Request
the next page with `--page 1`. Use `--size` to set the page size.

VKS reads work in `hcm-3` and `han-1` and support `--read-only`. `--project-id`
does not select a VKS workspace. Output contains account data.

Every list prints `{"Items": [...]}`, so a `--query` starts with `Items`.

| Flag     | Type  | Required |
| -------- | ----- | -------- |
| `--page` | `int` |          |
| `--size` | `int` |          |

```sh
greennode vks list-clusters \
  --query 'Items[].{ID:ID,Name:Name,Status:Status,Version:Version}' \
  --output table
```
